outcome: Spontaneous preterm birth before 37 weeks of gestation
Spontaneous preterm birth before 34 weeks of gestation
cohort: 104 women with a history of preterm birth and a transvaginal sonographic cervical length measurement of <= 25 mm, diagnosed between 24+0 and 33+6 weeks of gestation
finding: Progesterone treatment was associated with a reduction in rates of spontaneous preterm birth before 34 weeks of gestation, NICU admission, and neonatal length of stay in high-risk patients.
